ajnart-self-host-add-container.description: DCM Container work. Use to add or edit a Container in dcm/src/tools/, including an issue labelled `container` and then `accepted`, and the pull request dcm-add-container.yml opens from it. A Container is a compose snippet DCM offers for a product the Catalog does not install. Catalog Apps go to edit-catalog.

ajnart-self-host-edit-catalog.description: Catalog edits in Go. Use for any task that adds an App, changes an App's image, port, Compose, env, notes or StandaloneGuide (even a one-line image bump), changes a Recipe, or hides or unhides an App. Each of these changes generated site and DCM data and hand-kept App counts. DCM-only Containers go to add-container; Homarr wiring goes to docs/agents/homarr-integrations.md.

ajnart-self-host-release-visual.description: Generate the self-host release announcement visual when preparing a release or announcing newly added Apps. Discover added Apps between refs and render the approved Logo hub with pulses, rather than inventing a new layout.

ajnart-self-host-self-host.description: Load when the person wants to run or own apps on their own machine, replace a subscription (Netflix, Google Photos, Dropbox, a password manager), or asks about anything already set up with self-host, such as "where is my movie app?".
